description: This file contains a test suite for Git, specifically focusing on the 'resolve undo' functionality. It includes setup procedures, various test cases for resolving, unresolving, merging conflicts, rerere (reuse recorded resolution), and garbage collection interactions related to undoing resolutions.

methods.name: check_resolve_undo
methods.description: Checks the resolve-undo state against expected outcomes after various operations, by comparing actual and expected file states.

methods.name: prime_resolve_undo
methods.description: Sets up the repository state for testing resolve-undo scenarios, including resets and conflict resolution preparations.
